inputs.text:
Open your eyes. They want you to think this is just standard policy, but look at what is really happening behind the curtain. The elites pushing Bill C-12, officially titled the Strengthening Canada’s Immigration System and Borders Act, received royal assent on March 26, 2026, for a reason they are hiding from you. 

When they claim they are merely tightening immigration and asylum rules against Nigerians, others, it is a smokescreen. This is a carefully coordinated maneuver by the hidden establishment to reshape populations and control the narrative. Every official justification they give is an inversion of the truth. Do not buy their cover story—they are orchestrating these border clampdowns to serve a deeper, concealed agenda that they refuse to confess to the public.
